About the Blue Dream Strain

Blue Dream is a California legend, a cross of Blueberry and Haze that became one of the best-selling strains in the country for its easy, balanced high. It pairs sweet berry terpenes from the Blueberry side with the clear, cerebral lift of Haze.

Flavor and Terpene Profile

Live rosin preserves the terpenes that dry curing burns off, so Blue Dream tastes like the living plant:

  • Sweet blueberry and ripe berry up front
  • Herbal, hazy notes with a hint of vanilla
  • A clean, slightly sweet finish
  • Terpene profile commonly led by myrcene, pinene, and caryophyllene

Effects

Concentrates hit harder and faster than flower. Blue Dream rosin is a sativa-dominant hybrid best suited to daytime and all-day sessions. Users typically report:

  • A gentle, uplifting onset that builds smoothly

  • Electronic rigs and dab pens built for rosin, on their lowest settings
  • Top a bowl or joint with a small dab for extra potency and flavor

Start with a dab the size of a grain of rice. Rosin is a connoisseur-grade concentrate and a little goes a long way.

Blue Dream Live Rosin FAQ

What is live rosin?
Live rosin is a solventless concentrate made by pressing fresh-frozen bubble hash with heat and pressure. Because the plant is frozen at harvest instead of dried and cured, the terpene profile stays closer to the living flower.

Is live rosin stronger than flower?
Yes. Rosin concentrates the cannabinoids and terpenes of the plant, so effects come on faster and hit harder. Start small.

Is Blue Dream a sativa or indica?
Blue Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid. Expect a gentle, uplifting onset that builds smoothly and creative, motivated focus without racing energy. It suits daytime and all-day sessions.

How should I store rosin?
Sealed and cold. Refrigeration keeps the texture and terpenes stable. Let it warm for a few minutes before you dab.

Will Blue Dream show up on a drug test?
Yes. THCA converts to Delta-9 THC when heated, and standard drug tests detect it. If you are subject to drug testing, avoid THCA products.

products.title: Strawberry Cough THCA Flower
products.body_html:
Strawberry Cough is a sativa you can identify with your nose. Sweet strawberry, right out of the jar, and a smoke that expands in the chest and makes most people cough at least once. That cough is where the name comes from. Kyle Kushman made the strain popular in the early 2000s, and it has been quoted in cannabis culture ever since (there's the famous line in Pineapple Express). We grow ours indoors, hand-trim it, and have every batch tested by an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited third-party lab for total cannabinoid potency, terpene profile, and a full safety panel.

Lineage

People have argued about the exact parentage for two decades. The most accepted answer is Strawberry Fields x Original Haze. Kyle Kushman, a grower and cannabis writer, is the name most tied to it, since he championed the berry-forward terpenes and the uplifting effect.

Nobody argues about the smell. Open a jar and you'll know it in one breath. Very few strains have a terpene signature this easy to pick out.

Smell and taste

Sweet, ripe strawberry is the dominant note. Under that, berry and fruit candy, then a little skunk and herb at the back. The terpene profile is myrcene, terpinolene, and caryophyllene. The smoke is smooth and sweet with a fruity exhale, and then the cough.

About that cough. It comes from how the smoke expands and fills the lungs. It's chest pressure, not harshness, and it mostly gets people who try to hold a hit too long. Longtime sativa smokers know it's coming. For how terpenes shape a strain, see our terpenes guide.

How it hits

Mood lifts quickly, usually within 5-10 minutes. From there it's bright, social, talkative energy with a focused kind of clarity that doesn't race. There's a light body buzz and no sedation. Effects hold for 2-3 hours. A lot of people call it one of the most reliably "happy" strains around.

It's a daytime and social sativa. Pairs well with creative work, music, exercise, and conversation. Our Dream Walker is a similarly uplifting sativa with a different terpene profile (Dream Walker leans citrus and pine, Strawberry Cough leans berry and herbal).

Lab testing

Each batch ships with a batch-specific Certificate of Analysis (COA) from an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited third-party lab. It documents total cannabinoid potency, Delta-9 THC compliance (no more than 0.3% by dry weight per the 2018 Farm Bill), the full terpene profile, and the full safety panel.

Ways to smoke it

  • Pre-rolls for quick daytime sessions. See our THCA pre-roll collection.
  • Hand-rolled joints with a slim tip. It burns clean.
  • Glass pipes and bongs for fast onset. Don't try to hold the hit. That's how the cough gets you.
  • Dry herb vaporizers at lower temperatures keep the strawberry terpenes intact.
  • Vape carts and disposables: our THCA vape collection has sativa options.

If sativa flower is new to you, start with half a joint or a small bowl and wait 20 minutes before going again. Sativa feels different from an indica's body sedation. More head, less body.

Is Strawberry Cough a sativa or indica?
Sativa-dominant. The effect is uplifting and mood-lifting rather than heavy body sedation, which is why it's a common daytime pick.

Why is it called Strawberry Cough?
Two reasons. The sweet strawberry smell and flavor, and the chest-expanding cough a lot of people get on big hits. That side effect got it the name in the early 2000s.

What does Strawberry Cough taste like?
Sweet, ripe strawberry first, with herbal and slightly skunky notes underneath. Myrcene, terpinolene, and caryophyllene together make up the berry-forward flavor.

Is Strawberry Cough good for daytime use?

How we make it

Most hemp concentrates right now are solvent-extracted, refined down, and meant for a rig. This isn't that. Our THCA hash is dry-sifted: the trichome heads get separated from the plant material and then pressed by hand into dense slabs. No solvents, no CO2, no post-processing. Just pressed trichomes.

What you get is a firm block that gives a little under your thumb. It smells warm and earthy with a bit of spice. The texture is buttery but crumbles cleanly, so you can pinch off a piece for a bowl, slice a strip for a joint, or break it down for a hash pipe without it smearing everywhere. The smoke is creamy and woody, a lot rounder and more mellow than live badder or rosin.

How it hits

Hash builds slowly. A dab of badder or rosin hits fast and hard; this one creeps in over a few minutes and lands mostly in the body. Relaxing, kind of meditative. It's one of the easier THCA concentrates to get along with if a rig is too much for you, and it works for experienced smokers who want to wind down in the evening without doing a full dab session.

Evening product. Good with music, or for slowing down after a long day. Since it's less potent than modern extracts, it's a sensible step between THCA flower and the rest of the concentrates.

Ways to use it

  • Crumble a small piece over ground THCA flower in a bowl. Big potency bump, no rig needed.
  • Flatten a thin strip and lay it down the middle of your ground flower before you roll. Works well with our THCA pre-roll flower.
  • Hash pipe or chillum. Load a small piece by itself and you get the full flavor with nothing else in the way.
  • Hot knives or a vaporizer. If you know what you're doing, hash vapes well at low temperatures and the terpenes come through cleaner.

Hash vs. badder and rosin

If you're used to THCA live badder or THCA live rosin, this is a different thing. Those extracts usually run 70-90%+ THCA and hit immediately and hard. Hash is a lower concentration, slower onset, more body than head, and less likely to knock you sideways. They're for different moods. Plenty of concentrate regulars keep both around.

Live resin from fresh-frozen Gelato flower in a rechargeable disposable. No distillate, no botanical terpenes, no cutting agents. What is in the tank is the flavor and character of the strain itself: sweet, creamy and a little fruity.

Why live resin and not distillate

A distillate vape strips everything out except THC and then adds botanical terpenes back in for flavor. Live resin keeps the terpene profile that was in the flower when it was frozen. That is why it tastes fuller, feels smoother and gives you the whole entourage effect of the strain. If you have only ever used distillate carts, this will hit differently.

The Gelato profile

Gelato is a dessert strain. Sweet and creamy, a little fruity, with a finish that hangs around. The character is a balanced hybrid: bright and uplifting, not heavy, with a comfortable warmth in the body. We reach for it in social settings and at the end of the day.

There is no distillate blended in, no botanical terps and no cutting agents. It is full-spectrum live resin, and it carries itself like the indica it is.

How we make the resin

The flower gets flash-frozen right after harvest instead of being hung to dry, so the terpenes and cannabinoids that normally burn off during drying stay in the extract. You get more flavor and a fuller effect than a distillate cart, and the vapor is smoother too.

Purple Afghani traces back to the Hindu Kush mountain range, one of the oldest cannabis lineages there is. It smells earthy and grape-forward with a little floral on top and hash and spice underneath. The character is textbook heavy indica: a heavier evening profile that fits slower, low-key moments. Do not plan on being productive after it. Save it for the end of the day.
